g.text: How ReQuest transforms heterogeneous survey XML into a harmonized, multi-study question bank
Ingests any standard survey metadata format
Merges identical code lists & categories on upgrade:
altering a single table row in PostgreSQL.
Halts automatically on warnings or drift.
Streams file directly into core tables in
constant memory without JSONB storage bloat.
1 row records batch ID & created URNs.
The DDI Variable Cascade — Visual Walkthrough
Enables cross-survey comparisons by decoupling abstract measurement concepts from physical study columns
• QuestionItem: "En politique, on parle de gauche et de droite..." (urn:ddi:fr.cdsp:qi-lr-fr:1.0.0)
Eliminating intermediate staging tables cuts complexity, RAM, and database bloat
Bypasses raw XML staging in PostgreSQL JSONB tables,
preventing write amplification and WAL log explosion.
Receipts track all created URNs in a single batch row.
Parallel question texts, labels, and interviewer instructions
